section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Theft Deterrent System
title: Troubleshooting

items: Check that the operation of other systems (Door Lock Control, Open Door Warning ... etc.) are normal.
When the system is not operating, lower the door glass and confirm under what conditions it does not operate, or malfunctions.

rows: Theft deterrent system can not be set.
Theft deterrent system does not operate when LH door opened.
Theft deterrent system does not operate when RH door opened.
Theft deterrent system does not cancel when ignition switch turned on or ACC position.
Theft deterrent system does not cancel when LH door unlocked with key.
Theft deterrent system does not cancel when RH door unlocked with key.
Horn does not blow even if theft deterrent system operated.
Headlights and taillights do not flash even if theft deterrent system operated.
